# Self-hosted front-end assets

Pinned browser assets served from SISTER's own static files so the UI does not depend on a third-party CDN at render
time (copied from the identical versions vendored in the sibling `crowdaction` project). Upstream license terms apply.

| Package | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bootstrap | 5.3.2 | MIT | <https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap> |
| Font Awesome Free | 6.5.0 | Icons CC BY 4.0, fonts SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT | <https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome> |
| Tabulator | 6.3.1 | MIT | <https://github.com/olifolkerd/tabulator> |
| Chart.js | 4.4.4 | MIT | <https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js> |
| Inter (latin) | 5.2.8 | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-Inter.txt`) | <https://github.com/rsms/inter> via `@fontsource/inter` |
| Lexend (latin) | 5.2.11 | SIL OFL 1.1 (`fonts/OFL-Lexend.txt`) | <https://github.com/googlefonts/lexend> via `@fontsource/lexend` |
| SheetJS (xlsx) | 0.18.5 | Apache-2.0 (`xlsx-0.18.5/LICENSE`) | <https://github.com/SheetJS/sheetjs> |
